metrics.group_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-scene metrics over scenes with samples in that group; report contributing scene and event counts. Missing scene-phase values are null, not zero.

wording: For C00/PRE/RECOVERY report output amplitude together with target amplitude. Use neutral wording rather than automatically calling every nonzero prediction false compensation; empirical near-zero targets apply to the currently audited data, not arbitrary real-world wind torques.

signals.u: Current emitted normalized signed-rate command, dimensionless {-1,0,1}
signals.z: Four-dimensional causal internal command integral in seconds, z[k]=sum_i<k dt_i*u[i]
signals.a3: Weighted mean requested body torque over the immediately preceding complete event interval; excludes current event row. For MATLAB event index k and 10 ms spacing, rows k-10 through k-1.

resources: At most five diagnostic closed-form supervised fits, no optimizer steps, neural training, GPU, new rollouts or TEST access.
